text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $76k with modest overnight gains, while Ethereum is lagging with just 0.2% growth, suggesting risk appetite is cautious and rotational rather than broadly bullish. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (51) with a week-long decline of 15 points, indicating a loss of momentum and growing uncertainty despite prices remaining stable. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.5% paired with $92B in daily volume reflects a market taking a pause—not capitulating, but also not aggressively risk-on.
